# Matthews Real Estate Investment Services
> Matthews™ is a national commercial real estate (CRE) firm with 30+ offices across the United States and $88.37B in completed transactions. The firm provides investment sales, debt & structured finance, equity, leasing, auction services, and a 1031 exchange program, supported by market research and a nationwide network of specialized agents.
Matthews serves private investors, institutions, and developers across asset classes including retail, shopping centers, industrial, multifamily, self storage, healthcare/medical, hospitality, and mixed-use. Headquartered in the U.S. with national reach and local market expertise. Contact: 866-889-0550, contact@matthews.com.
## Services
- [All Services](https://www.matthews.com/services): Overview of Matthews' commercial real estate service lines
- [Investment Sales](https://www.matthews.com/services/investment-sales): Acquisition and disposition advisory for commercial real estate investments
- [Debt & Structured Finance](https://www.matthews.com/services/debt-structured-finance): Customized debt financing solutions for CRE investments
- [Equity](https://www.matthews.com/services/equity): Equity placement and capital markets services
- [Leasing](https://www.matthews.com/services/leasing): Strategic leasing solutions to maximize asset performance and occupancy
- [Auction Services](https://www.matthews.com/services/auctions): Accelerated property disposition through structured auctions
- [1031 Exchange Program](https://www.matthews.com/services/1031-exchange-program): Tax-deferred exchange solutions for real estate investors
